description: This file contains Jest test cases for React components related to form flows in an educational platform, including creation of courses and assignments, and submitting assignments. It mocks external dependencies like the Supabase client and tests various success and error scenarios.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Setup mock implementations for Supabase client before each test.

methods.name: test
methods.description: Multiple test cases evaluating the success and failure flows of creating courses, creating assignments, and submitting assignments in the UI.
